title: Aws Security Advisories - 2026-10-22
description:
Merged 4 aws security advisories published on 2026-10-22. Original advisory IDs: 2026-146-aws, 2026-145-aws, 2026-144-aws, 2026-147-aws

Titles:
- CVE-2026-115419 - Unintended disclosure of data element to wrong session in Strands Agents SDK A2A Server
- CVE-2026-115414 - OS Command Injection Issue in SAM CLI Terraform Hook
- CVE-2026-115416 - Incorrect authorization checks in Amazon Athena engine version 3 query processing
- CVE-2026-115417 - Memory allocation with excessive size value in the MQTT 3.1.1 compatibility adapter in aws-c-mqtt
